lines.en: label halloweenfive9:
scene continuingrestart1
: So basically, a few minutes ago, we were several years into the future, but...also still freshmen in high school because we’ve been caught in a time loop for an indeterminate amount of time.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，几分钟前我们还在几年后的未来，但……同时也还是高一新生，因为我们被困在一个时间长河里，时间长度不明。

lines.en: : Are we roleplaying? Because it sounds like we’re roleplaying, but you guys both look super serious.
lines.zh: : 我们是在角色扮演吗？因为听起来像角色扮演，可你们俩看起来都超严肃。

lines.en: : So you really don’t remember any of that? No...Apocalypse Squad or...end-of-the-world slumber parties with Yumi, Noriko, and Sana?
lines.zh: : 所以你真的什么都不记得了？没有……末日小队，或者……和 Yumi、Noriko、Sana 一起开的世界末日睡衣派对？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart2
: Wait, Yumi’s involved in this? And who the heck is Noriko? I’m going to need some background information if I’m going to play my role correctly, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 等等，Yumi 也掺和进来了？Noriko 到底是谁？我要演好自己的角色，总得先了解点背景信息吧，Makoto。

lines.en: : Unbelievable...
lines.zh: : 难以置信……

lines.en: : We really did go back several years then...
lines.zh: : 那我们真的回到了几年前……

lines.en: : But only you and me...why? How?
lines.zh: : 可只有你和我……为什么？怎么做到的？

lines.en: : I have no clue...but Ayane doesn’t seem to be interrupting us when we mention the state of the universe either, so...maybe she’s still...somehow privy to all of this? And just...doesn’t remember it?
lines.zh: : 我毫无头绪……不过我们提到宇宙状态时，Ayane 也没有打断我们，所以……也许她仍然……在某种程度上知晓这一切？只是……不记得了？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart3

: Wait...are you guys trying to say that this isn’t some kind of roleplay thing? That you, like...actually time-traveled here from several years in the future? When? And why didn’t you say anything until now?
lines.zh: : 等等……你们是在说这不是什么角色扮演？你们，就是……真的从几年后的未来穿越到这里了？什么时候？为什么到现在才说？

lines.en: : Because it literally just happened, Ayane. So did you notice either one of us acting...peculiar a few moments ago? Or anything else that seemed out of the ordinary today?
lines.zh: : 因为它字面意义上刚刚发生，Ayane。那你有没有注意到我们刚才谁表现得……有点古怪？或者今天还有什么别的异常？

lines.en: : I’m sorry for the barrage of questions, I just...this isn’t something I really have any idea how to approach. Especially when, to me, you were an entirely different person just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉问题连珠炮，我只是……这件事我真的不知道该怎么切入。尤其对我来说，一分钟前的你完全是另一个人。

lines.en: : You guys have seemed normal all day. Everyone has. But what was I like if I’m different from the way I am now?
lines.zh: : 你们今天一整天看起来都很正常。大家都一样。可既然我和现在不一样，那我是个什么样？

lines.en: : You were kind of the one leading the charge for all of this time stuff. Which is why both of us have no idea where to go from here as this was something we were entirely unprepared for.
lines.zh: : 你基本是带头处理所有这些时间问题的人。所以我和他都不知道接下来该怎么办——这件事我们完全没有准备。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart4
: Wait, I was the leader? Why? I don’t know the first thing about time travel. Wouldn’t you be way more suited for something like that, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 等等，我是领头的？为什么？我对时间旅行一窍不通。这种事不是你更合适吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : On a technical level, yes. But I placed my priorities elsewhere as you two were the ones who cared more about “fixing” things than I ever did.
lines.zh: : 从技术上讲是的。但我把重心放在了别处，因为你们两个比我更在乎「修复」这些事。

lines.en: : Ayane...what do you remember? What am I to you? What is Makoto to you?
lines.zh: : Ayane……你记得什么？我对你来说是什么？Makoto 对你来说是什么？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart5
: Well...Makoto is just Makoto, I guess. We don’t really talk much. And you’re my teacher.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Makoto 就是 Makoto 吧。我们其实不怎么说话。而你是我的老师。

lines.en: : Just your teacher?
lines.zh: : 只是老师？

lines.en: : That is a leading question that I refuse to answer in public.
lines.zh: : 这是个诱导性问题，我拒绝在公共场合回答。

lines.en: : Do you have sex with him or not? Answer honestly, we’re in the information gathering phase here.
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有和他上床？老实回答，我们现在处于信息收集阶段。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart6
: D-Do I what?! Sensei and me?! W-What are you saying?!
lines.zh: : 我、我什么？！我和 Sensei？！你、你在说什么啊？！

lines.en: : Just tell her, Ayane. It doesn’t need to be a secret in this timeline. Makoto already knows in the other one.
lines.zh: : 就告诉她吧，Ayane。在这个时间线里不用保密。Makoto 在另一条里已经知道了。

lines.en: : Knows what?! W-W-We’ve never done anything even c...close to that before! Ami would kill me! And you’re...you...you don’t see me that way at all! Not even close!
lines.zh: : 知道什么？！我、我、我们连接近那种事的事都没做过！Ami 会杀了我的！而且你……你……你根本不是那样看我的！差得远了！

lines.en: : You two fuck like rabbits where we come from.
lines.zh: : 在我们那边，你们俩像兔子一样交配。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart7
: We do?...
lines.zh: : 我们吗？……

lines.en: : You’re practically husband and wife.
lines.zh: : 你们简直是老夫老妻。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart8
: Why does this alternate reality sound so much better than mine?! I want to go to that one instead! Unless this is a joke and/or setup! If it is, just pretend I never said that!
lines.zh: : 为什么那个平行现实听起来比我的好这么多？！我想去那边！除非这是个玩笑或者圈套！如果是，就当我没说过！

lines.en: : Was Ayane always this cute? Is this what happens in a world where she isn’t being constantly ravaged by you?
lines.zh: : Ayane 一直都这么可爱吗？这就是在一个她没有一直被你蹂躏的世界里会发生的吗？

lines.en: : That’s enough, Makoto. Ayane clearly doesn’t know anything. We’re not going to gain anything from questioning her. But maybe if we talk to Maya-
lines.zh: : 够了，Makoto。Ayane 显然什么都不知道。问她也得不到什么。不过也许我们跟 Maya 谈谈——

lines.en: scene continuingrestart9
: Maya...
lines.zh: : Maya……

lines.en: : She should still be here...
lines.zh: : 她应该还在这儿……

lines.en: : You’re right! She was caught up in this stuff way before you and Ayane were, wasn’t she? Maybe she’ll have an idea of-
lines.zh: : 对！她卷进这些事比你和 Ayane 都早，不是吗？也许她有办法——

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt, but who are you talking about now?
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，你们现在在说谁？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart10
: Maya. You know...the girl you and Ami are always hanging out with?
lines.zh: : Maya。你知道……就是你和 Ami 总黏在一起的那个女孩？

lines.en: : Oh, you mean Sana. The one who sits in the back of class, right? I know she’s quiet, but I figured you two at least knew her name.
lines.zh: : 哦，你是说 Sana。就是坐在教室最后面的那个，对吧？我知道她很安静，但我觉得你们俩至少知道她的名字吧。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart11
: Well, this certainly makes everything a lot more complicated all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这突然让一切变得复杂多了。

lines.en: : Hah...hahahah...
lines.zh: : 哈……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : S...Sensei? Is everything-
lines.zh: : S……Sensei？你还好——

lines.en: scene continuingrestart12
: Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都好吗？

lines.en: : Oh! L...Looks like Ami’s here now! My job is done! Bye, guys! I promise I wasn’t hitting on him, Ami! They came up to me!
lines.zh: : 哦！看、看来 Ami 来了！我的任务完成了！拜了，各位！我发誓我没有在勾引他，Ami！是他们找上我的！

lines.en: : Ignore her. What’s going on? Are you having a panic attack? Can I help?
lines.zh: : 别理她。怎么了？你在惊恐发作吗？我能帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Ami...you remember Maya, don’t you?...
lines.zh: : Ami……你记得 Maya，对吧？……

lines.en: : Who? Is she a friend of yours or something?
lines.zh: : 谁？她是你的朋友什么的吗？

lines.en: : This...has quickly become a much worse scenario than I originally thought.
lines.zh: : 这……迅速演变成比我最初设想的糟糕得多的局面。

lines.en: : Also, why are you hanging around Makoto? Didn’t I tell you she’s the kind of girl who will try to steal your bodily fluids and freeze them for later use? You should stay away from her.
lines.zh: : 还有，你为什么跟 Makoto 混在一起？我不是说过她是那种会偷走你的体液、冻起来留着以后用的女生吗？你应该离她远点。

lines.en: : You really don’t remember, Ami?...
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得了，Ami？……

lines.en: scene continuingrestart13
: No...but you know you can lean on me if you’re feeling lost and confused, right? I get how hard it is for you to remember stuff when you’re feeling overwhelmed.
lines.zh: : 不记得……但你知道如果你感到迷茫和困惑，可以依靠我，对吧？我知道你在不知所措的时候很难记起事情。

lines.en: : Did you at least take your pills today? I have some of them in my bag if you need any. Just let me know.
lines.zh: : 你今天至少吃过药了吗？我包里有几片，你要的话。跟我说一声就行。

lines.en: : Ami, could you give Sensei and me a minute alone? He’s going to slip into another state of catatonia at this-
lines.zh: : Ami，能让我和 Sensei 单独待一会儿吗？他就要滑进另一种木僵状态了——

lines.en: scene continuingrestart14
: Sorry, who the heck do you think you are exactly? You don’t know the first thing about taking care of him, you obsessive, four-eyed loser. Why should I give you a minute with him at all?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你到底以为你是谁啊？你根本不懂怎么照顾他，你这个偏执的四眼 loser。我凭什么要让你跟他单独待一分钟？

lines.en: : Sensei, surely you’ll stick up for me given the...circumstances, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei，鉴于……情况，你总会替我说句话吧？

lines.en: : Bzzt. Looks like no one loves you after all. Please leave now.
lines.zh: : 哔哔。看来到底还是没人爱你啊。请离开吧。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart15
How did this happen?...
lines.zh: 怎么会变成这样？……

lines.en: Undoing all of my progress while stripping me of the one thing I’d hold onto if given a choice is a fate worse than death...
lines.zh: 把我所有的进展全部作废，同时夺走我若有选择唯一会抓住的东西——这是比死亡更糟的命运……

lines.en: Do I need to die now? Is that the path I need to take to make things right again?
lines.zh: 我现在需要去死吗？那是让一切重回正轨的必经之路吗？

lines.en: If I hang myself from the rafters for all to see, will I wake up in a world where she exists again?
lines.zh: 如果我在众目睽睽之下把自己吊在房梁上，我会在一个她依然存在的世界里醒来吗？

lines.en: Or will the next time I’m greeted by the glow of the sun pouring into a mostly-empty classroom feel just as lonely as this?
lines.zh: 还是说，下一次当阳光洒进那间空荡荡的教室迎接我时，那份孤独会和现在一模一样？

lines.en: [[PAREIDOLIA DOES NOT EXIST. THERE IS NO ONE PRESENT TO PROVIDE COLOR COMMENTARY ON AKIRA ARAKAWA’S CURRENT THOUGHT PROCESS.]
lines.zh: [[PAREIDOLIA 并不存在。没有人能为 AKIRA ARAKAWA 当前的思维过程提供现场解说。]

lines.en: Even the voice in my head has left me behind...
lines.zh: 连我脑海里的声音都离我而去了……

lines.en: Now all I can do is rot somewhere else I’m not meant to be.
lines.zh: 现在我只能在我本不该待的另一个地方腐烂。

lines.en: : Okay. Sorry, Ami. I...get what this probably looks like from your perspective. But if it’s not a problem, I’d like to maybe try and explain why Sensei is like this and...where we were just a moment ago.
lines.zh: : 好吧。抱歉，Ami。我……明白从你的角度看这大概像什么。不过如果没问题的话，我想试着解释一下 Sensei 为什么会这样，以及……我们刚才在哪儿。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart16
: What are you talking about? You guys have been here for like four hours. And I know that for a fact since I’ve been keeping my eye on you the whole time!
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？你们俩在这儿待了大概四个小时了。这一点我敢肯定，因为我一直在盯着你们！

lines.en: : I’m sure that’s how it looks. But the truth is that Sensei and I...and please don’t mock me for saying this...were just teleported here from a different timeline.
lines.zh: : 我相信看起来是这样。但事实是，Sensei 和我……拜托别笑我这么说……刚从另一条时间线被传送过来。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart17
: Oh, why didn’t you just say so? That makes perfect sense.
lines.zh: : 哦，那你早说不就好了？完全说得通啊。

lines.en: : It...It does?
lines.zh: : 真、真的？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart18
: No, you friggin’ moron! How dumb do you think I am that I’d just buy that super crazy story?!
lines.zh: : 不，你这白痴！你以为我有多蠢，会信那种离谱故事？！

lines.en: : I know how it sounds! That’s why I asked you not to mock me! But that’s seriously what happened!
lines.zh: : 我知道听起来很荒唐！所以我才叫你别笑我！但这真的是发生的事！

lines.en: : Oh, and I’m guessing there were also flying cars and hover-boards too?
lines.zh: : 哦，那我猜那边还有飞行汽车和悬浮滑板咯？

lines.en: : No! Just the occasional apocalypse and...an exponentially larger harem.
lines.zh: : 没有！只是偶尔来一次世界末日，以及……呈指数级扩张的后宫。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart19
: Well, there’s no “harem” here. So I suggest you run along and bother somebody else so you’re not bothering my dad anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这儿可没有什么「后宫」。所以我建议你滚去烦别人，别再烦我爸爸了。

lines.en: : Honestly, Makoto — you’re lucky he hasn’t had you sent to another class yet with how much time you spend trying to get into his pants.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Makoto——你花那么多时间想钻进他裤子里，他没把你调到其他班去已经算你走运了。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart20
: He lets me into those pants willingly, you delusional red-headed freak!
lines.zh: : 他是心甘情愿让我进那条裤子的，你这个妄想的红毛怪胎！

lines.en: : HA! As-if! Sensei has everything he could need and more already! You’re lucky he even gives you the time of day!
lines.zh: : 哈！才怪！Sensei 已经拥有他需要的一切，甚至更多！他愿意搭理你你就该谢天谢地了！

lines.en: : And you’re lucky he hasn’t put you up for adoption yet with how unbearably annoying you are! Now stop trying to attach yourself to his hip and just listen to me for a second!
lines.zh: : 而你也该谢天谢地——以你烦人到让人忍无可忍的程度，他还没把你送人收养呢！现在别再黏在他身上了，听我说一秒钟！

lines.en: : You can talk as much as you want, Makoto! All I hear is “blah blah blah!” Oh! And another thing! You-
lines.zh: : 你想说多少说多少，Makoto！我听到的全是「blah blah blah」！哦！还有一件事！你——

lines.en: : She called me “Dad...”
lines.zh: : 她叫我「爸爸」……

lines.en: scene continuingrestart21
: Huh?
: She was still my niece the last time we were here...
lines.zh: : 上次我们在这儿的时候，她还是我的侄女……

lines.en: : She didn’t start calling me “Dad” until years later...
lines.zh: : 她要到好几年后才开始叫我「爸爸」……

lines.en: scene continuingrestart22
: Wait, yeah...why did you call him that?
lines.zh: : 等等，对……你为什么那么叫他？

lines.en: : Hey, I only agreed to call him “Sensei” during school hours because I’d get in trouble if I didn’t! But these ain’t school hours, Makoto! I’m calling him “Dad” all night and you can’t stop me!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我答应只在上课时间叫他「Sensei」，因为不叫会有麻烦！但现在可不是上课时间，Makoto！我整晚都要叫他「爸爸」，你拦不住我！

lines.en: : But he’s your uncle.
lines.zh: : 可他是你叔叔。

lines.en: : What? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么？你在说什么？

lines.en: : He said just a second ago that you’re his niece. And while he may act like a father figure, the fact remains that you’ve somehow carried a late-stage development to an earlier time where-
lines.zh: : 他刚刚才说你是他侄女。虽然他表现得像个父亲，但事实是你把后期的发展带到了更早的时间点，导致——

lines.en: : Dad, just tell her you misspoke. You know I’m your real daughter, right?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，你就跟她说你口误了吧。你知道我是你真正的女儿，对吧？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart23
: Real...daughter?...
lines.zh: : 真正的……女儿？……

lines.en: scene continuingrestart24
: Mhm! You’re probably just confused because you’re about to have another mental breakdown. Or you’ve got that Owzymer’s thingy or whatever it’s called. But you know who I really am, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！你大概是又要精神崩溃了所以搞混了。或者你得了那个叫什么 Owzymer 的什么症之类的。可你知道我到底是谁，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 哦我的天……

lines.en: : You’re my...real daughter?...
lines.zh: : 你是我的……真正的女儿？……

lines.en: : Sensei...uhh...
lines.zh: : Sensei……呃……

lines.en: : How do I put this?...
lines.zh: : 我该怎么说呢？……

lines.en: : Of course, silly! Oh, and look! Here comes proof!
lines.zh: : 当然啦，傻瓜！哦，看！证据来了！

lines.en: scene continuingrestart25
: Mom! Daddy is pretending I’m not his real daughter again!
lines.zh: : 妈妈！爸爸又在假装我不是他真正的女儿了！

lines.en: : Aki-kuuuun. No hurting Ami’s feelings. She’s living through what is arguably the most impressionable part of her life, you know.
lines.zh: : Aki 君。别伤 Ami 的心。她正处在可以说是一生中最容易受影响的阶段，你知道的。

lines.en: : ...Sekai?
lines.zh: : ……Sekai？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart26
: Wow. I haven’t heard you call me by my real name in years. It’s always “darling” or “baby.” Or “Mommy” after 10:00 PM and Ami is in bed.
lines.zh: : 哇。我已经好几年没听你叫我的本名了。平时不是「亲爱的」就是「宝贝」。或者晚上十点后、Ami 睡了叫「妈妈」。

lines.en: : I’m going to pretend I didn’t just hear that.
lines.zh: : 我打算假装我刚才没听见。

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m...going to go stand off to the side for a minute...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我……要去旁边站一会儿……

lines.en: : You can come get me whenever you...yeah...
lines.zh: : 你……嗯……随时可以来找我……

lines.en: scene continuingrestart27
: Ugh! Finally. She’s acting super weird today and it was making me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 呃！总算走了。她今天超级怪，让我很不舒服。

lines.en: : Is something wrong with Makoto? She seems a little...shaken.
lines.zh: : Makoto 有什么事吗？她看起来有点……发抖。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart28
: It’s just...how she seems? I don’t really know how to describe it.
lines.zh: : 只是……她看起来那样？我真的不知道该怎么形容。

lines.en: : No...how are you here? You’re dead.
lines.zh: : 不……你怎么会在这儿？你死了。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart29
: I am?!
lines.zh: : 我死了？！

lines.en: : She is?!
lines.zh: : 她死了？！

lines.en: : Yes! And all of this...all of this is because of you! What I am! Who I became! It’s all because of what you did to me! How you left me all alone!
lines.zh: : 对！而这一切……这一切都是因为你！我成了什么样子！我变成谁！全都是你对我做的事造成的！你是怎么把我一个人丢下的！

lines.en: scene continuingrestart30
: Jeez, Aki-kun. I just went to pick up some snacks for the girls. If I had known it’d be such an issue, I’d have brought you along with me.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Aki 君。我只是去给女孩们买点零食。早知道会这么麻烦，我就带你一起去了。

lines.en: : I think he’s having another one of his things, Mom. But he doesn’t want to take his medication. I already tried. It’s probably something Makoto said that triggered him.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他又在发作了，妈妈。但他不肯吃药。我已经试过了。大概是 Makoto 说了什么刺激到他。

lines.en: scene continuingrestart31
: I’m sure he’ll snap out of it on his own, baby. It’s nothing you have to worry about. Now, go have fun with your friends. I’ll take care of your father.
lines.zh: : 我相信他自己会缓过来的，宝贝。这不用你操心。现在，去和你的朋友们玩吧。你爸爸交给我来照顾。

lines.en: : There’s really nothing I can do to help?
lines.zh: : 真的没什么我能帮上忙的吗？

lines.en: : You? Not right now.
lines.zh: : 你？现在不行。

lines.en: scene black
: But if Makoto has an idea of what might have triggered this, I’d love to hear from her as to what might have happened. Could you grab her for me, baby?
lines.zh: : 不过如果 Makoto 知道是什么触发了这个，我很想听听她的说法，看看到底发生了什么。能帮我叫她过来吗，宝贝？

lines.en: : Ughhhh! Fine...
lines.zh: : 呜啊啊啊！好吧……

lines.en: : Makoto! Can you come back over here for a second?! My mom needs you!
lines.zh: : Makoto！你能过来一下吗？！我妈妈找你！

lines.en: : I...have no idea what’s going on right now...
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道现在是什么情况……

jump halloweenayane1
